plan.description: Reads plan.md, tasks.md, requirements.md and breaks work into atomic shippable tasks. Maintains task status tracking across phases.

review.description: Reviews code against ArcGIS non-negotiable rules, TypeScript strict mode, and design system tokens. Catches violations before commit.

docker-up.description: Start PostgreSQL and Keycloak containers (data persists in named volumes — no seeding needed)

docker-down.description: Stop containers (data preserved). Use docker-down -v to also wipe volumes for a clean reset

dev.description: Start full local environment: docker-up → pnpm server (Express :8000) → pnpm dev (Vite :5173)

build-check.description: Run TypeScript type-check (tsc -b) then Vite production build, followed by pnpm lint

lint-fix.description: Run ESLint with auto-fix across all source files, then confirm build still passes

seed.description: Seed test users and sample submissions — only needed after a full volume wipe (docker compose down -v)

migrate.description: Re-apply db/init.sql schema manually — only needed after a full volume wipe
